text_block_list.text:
The one who seized victory on the stage of 
the Kikuka Sho was Mejiro McQueen, proudly 
demonstrating her mastery over 
long-distance races.

Mejiro Ryan showed her frustration at the 
gap in ability between them.

Mejiro McQueen gave her words of 
encouragement, expressing hope to see her 
bring that same dynamic burst in the final 
furlong of her next race.

The curtain fell on the Kikuka Sho, and 
the next battle was the Arima Kinen. 
Mejiro Ryan made her move toward a race 
where unknown, formidable rivals awaited.
